verdict.rationale: Vercel's Support Terms publish a severity-based response-time table for Enterprise Standard and Premium support tiers, but they state that Vercel only commits to response times for Enterprise subscriptions, and the times are framed as targets rather than guarantees. Missing for 10: response-time commitments for Hobby/Pro tiers, documented escalation paths, firm guaranteed (not target) response SLAs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier

citations.quote: The table below outlines our target response time guidelines for our various support tiers of the Enterprise subscription.
We only commit to respond to Customers with an Enterprise subscription, using the target response time guidelines below.
